The comparison the button, the panel prompt, and the provided purpose all advertise never appears in the captured page. The sibling 'Show PM2.5' button worked under the same procedure (E01).

contextual_exceptions.observation: Averaging labels differ across regions: the header says readings are averaged over September 2026 and the method note says hourly values are averaged per day then per month, while the reading panel heads the default value 'Current reading' and labels ozone as an 8-hour average. The PM2.5 state (S02) is labeled monthly mean, matching the header.

evidence.description: Default ozone value with an 8-hour averaging label.

evidence.quote: Hourly values are averaged per day, then per month.

evidence.description: PM2.5 value after E01, labeled consistently with the header.

contextual_exceptions.rationale: An 8-hour average is the conventional averaging time for reporting ozone, so a monthly mean of daily 8-hour values would reconcile all three texts, and 'current' is a common dashboard label for the latest period. The labels are loose rather than shown to conflict, so this is not counted as SUB-02.

observation_confidence.reason: All wording is captured exactly in DOM text spans; only the interpretation is uncertain.

summary.text: A short, plain neighborhood air-quality readout: title and data scope, two buttons and a download link, one reading panel, and a method note. The main observation is behavioral. In a completed recorded click (E02) the 'Compare with last year' button changed nothing: no text, no ARIA or input state, and its after-state screenshot is byte-identical to the before state. The comparison it advertises, which the panel prompt and the provided purpose also name, never appears in the captured page. The sibling 'Show PM2.5' button worked under the same procedure (E01), so this is a control-specific failure, not a capture-wide script failure. 'Download CSV' was not exercised and is not judged. Surface styling (Verdana, white background, outlined green buttons, one bordered panel) and the specific copy (place, sensor count, month, sensor model, correction formula) showed no codebook surface, layout, copy, or substance pattern. A loose averaging label on the ozone reading is recorded as a contextual exception, not a finding. Evidence covers one desktop viewport and one click per control; nothing here bears on who or what made the page.
major_limitations: Desktop viewport only (1280x800, one scroll position); no mobile or keyboard-focus evidence.
Each button was clicked once on a fresh load with an 800 or 1200 ms window; combinations such as comparing after selecting PM2.5 are untested.
Download CSV link was not exercised (it would leave the page); its behavior is unknown, not broken.
No source excerpts, so SRC-01 is unassessed and the cause of the E02 failure cannot be examined.
Profile multimodal-core was used as requested; the data-story module (DAT-01 to DAT-04) was not applied although the provided genre is a data dashboard.
Synthetic development fixture: the context was written by the fixture author.
